text: Chapter Secretary Checklist Immediately Following Election: Meet with outgoing secretary to discuss transition Gain access to communication tools (Email, GIN System, etc.) Review Secretary Handbook Review and National Constitution & Bylaws Review Chapter Bylaws Submit Chapter Officer Election Report (MySinfonia) Within 2 Weeks of Election: Review Chapter Member Roster (MySinfonia) Ensure emails, mailing address, phone numbers are up to date on MySinfonia Ensure all collegiate members are on current Chapter Member Roster Weekly Tasks: Weekly Secretary Report Send meeting/event reminder notifications to members Distribute weekly meeting agenda Collect weekly Officer/Committee Reports for meeting minutes Record Chapter Meeting Minutes during meetings Roll Call during Chapter Meeting Distribute Chapter Meeting Minutes Attend Executive Committee Meeting Attend Chapter Meeting Attend chapter events and functions – motivating others to do so as well Semester – Fall Expectations: Work with Chapter President on Chapter Report – Due on October 15 Review Chapter Member Roster (MySinfonia) Ensure emails, mailing address, phone numbers are up to date on MySinfonia Ensure all collegiate members are on current Chapter Member Roster Semester – Spring Expectations: Work with Chapter President on Chapter Report – Due on March 15 Review Chapter Member Roster (MySinfonia) Ensure emails, mailing address, phone numbers are up to date on MySinfonia Ensure all collegiate members are on current Chapter Member Roster As Needed Expectations: Send out Membership Status notification updates Notification of motion to suspend or expel Notification of suspension or expulsion Notify Lyrecrest of any member status changes within 30 days
